name: Modine Manufacturing

verdict.label: Speculative
verdict.oneLine: Modine rode data-centre chillers from about $3 to over $300, then halved; the question is whether warm-water cooling removes the chiller.

summary: Modine went from about $3 a share in 2020 to over $300 in 2026 by selling the chillers and air handlers that carry heat out of AI data centres. Then it fell by half, and Nvidia's CEO said its next chips may not need chillers at all. The film answers seven questions with filings and data, including a weather model for warm-water cooling and three modeled routes to 2030. Spin-adjusted valuation figures are estimates, and the report naming the $4B customer is unconfirmed by the company.
disclosure: Matt does not own shares of Modine and was not paid by anyone to make this video.
change: First page, built from the October 2026 film. Q2 FY2027 results (late October 2026) are not yet reflected.
